definition: A state of raised stakes, especially with respect to the opposing team. Tension appears when two competing interests from opposing [players](/term/player) collide, even without active [combat](/term/combat). The presence of tension accentuates losses and gains—for each interest fulfilled by one side, an equivalent interest is lost for the other. Tension scales with both [variance](/term/variance) and [value](/term/value). The greater the variance in outcome or the greater the value of the outcome, the higher the tension rises.
